current_evidence: The council's 'Planning forms and validation requirements' page links the 'Local Validation Document Checklist and guidance 28 September' as the 'local list of additional documents', together with a 'Local Validation List - Matrix'. Grokbot's link is an old per-form Reserved Matters checklist on the edrms server.

issues.detail: Grokbot's 'Validation list URL' is the 'M. Approval of Reserved Matters Application checklist (23)', a single application-type form checklist and not the local list. Its supporting docs (B Planning Permission checklist REV March 2014, C Outline, E Listed Building, K Hedgerow, L Demolition) are also old per-form checklists. The edrms server blocks automated fetching (robots disallowed), so the link could not be verified directly. The actual Local List is the 'Local Validation Document Checklist and Guidance on Content' plus the 'Local Validation List - Matrix' on bedford.gov.uk.
issues.evidence: Planning forms and validation requirements page: 'local list of additional documents' -> local-validation-document-checklist-and-guidance-28-september.pdf; 'matrix' -> local-validation-list-matrix.pdf

issues.detail: The List date of 2018-01-01 comes from PDF metadata of the old checklist. The current local list is dated '28 September' (year not stated, but it cites 2025 documents, so it is probably 2025).
issues.evidence: Link title 'Local Validation Document Checklist and guidance 28 September.pdf'; text cites 'Statement of Community Involvement (2025)'

issues.detail: Grokbot missed nearly all of Bedford's local list items. Missing are: Agricultural/rural workers' dwelling appraisal; Agricultural Land Classification and Soil Statement (Grade 1/2/3a); Air Quality Assessment (12 categories incl. 300+ parking spaces, roads >10,000 vpd, AQMA); Daylight/Sunlight Assessment; Decommissioning and Site Restoration Plan (renewables, grid infrastructure); Economic Statement; Emergency Services Statement; Fire Statement (>18m or 7+ storeys); Health Impact Assessment (50+ dwellings, 5ha+ employment, retail >500 sqm); Housing Statement (10+ dwellings); Land Contamination Assessment; LVIA (EIA, all solar/wind, majors outside settlement boundaries); Landscape Proposals (outline/full/RM where landscaping determined); Lighting Statement; Marketing Strategy (loss of shops/pubs, 12 months); Noise Impact Assessment; Open Space Assessment; Parking Provision (all applications involving parking); Planning Obligations Heads of Terms; Planning Statement (majors); Retail/Town Centre (sequential test; RIA >2,500 sqm); Viability; Statement of Community Involvement (all majors); Structural Survey (barn conversions, listed buildings); Surface and Foul Water Drainage (major full/RM); Sustainability Statement (all majors); Telecoms statement; Transport Assessment/Statement; Travel Plan; Ventilation/Extraction; Waste Audit (all new dwellings need waste storage); BNG self-build exemption form; CIL forms (all applications).
issues.evidence: Local Validation Document Checklist and Guidance on Content, full table of items

issues.detail: The trigger excerpts are column-merged text from the form checklists and do not read coherently. Examples: Design and Access Statement 'Only required if your This is a short report accompanying and supporting a planning dwelling is located within application'; Flood Risk 'Only required if your This should be a short written statement confirming EITHER (i) dwelling is located with floor le...'; 'Highways / access details' is actually block-plan text about trees ('The location, species and spread of all trees...'). The local list FRA trigger is Flood Zones 2/3 (all development), 1ha+ in Flood Zone 1, or within 8m of a main river.
issues.evidence: Local list FRA: 'All new development in Flood Zones 2 and 3 ... 1ha+ sites in Flood Zone 1 ... within 8m of a main river bank'

issues.detail: Householder is shown as '(none)', but the matrix has a Householder column and the local list applies FRA (Flood Zones 2/3 incl. householder), Ecology (incl. hedge/tree/pond removal at householder scale), Daylight/Sunlight (SPG impact on neighbours), Heritage, Trees and CIL to householders. Full planning rows are all marked 'INFERRED ... placed under Full planning'. The 'Change of use - prior approval' rows (Biodiversity, Waste audits, Structural survey, Minerals/Waste statements, Planning Statement) come from the demolition prior-notification checklist and the generic list. The matrix explicitly excludes prior approval submissions.
issues.evidence: Matrix: columns Householder, Major, Minor, Change of Use, Advert, Listed Building Works ...; 'excludes ... prior approval submissions'

issues.detail: Several rows are national drawing standards or process text rather than local requirements: both tab_items ('Site/Block Plan at a scale of 1:500 or 1:200...' and 'North point to be clearly shown.'); the Block plan, Elevations and Roof plan rows under Outline and Reserved matters; and 'Pre-application advice ... also provide pre-application advice for a fee'.
issues.evidence: tab_items section 'Drawing / document standards'; prior approval row 'also provide pre-application advice for a fee.'

issues.detail: The 'Planning page' in the reference_row is the council homepage (https://www.bedford.gov.uk), not the planning validation page. The correct page is the 'Planning forms and validation requirements' page.

summary: Grokbot linked an old per-form Reserved Matters checklist, not Bedford's Local Validation Document Checklist and Guidance (28 September, probably 2025) and its matrix. Almost all of about 35 local requirements are missing, and the triggers it did capture are garbled column-merged text.
